avis.titre: Very light scent, light, lovely moisturizer - slightly clammy for a few minutes after applyingVery light scent, light, l
avis.texte: My first impression of this product before even trying it - the design colors of the bottle and box is NOT well thought out! Unless you have very good eyes, you're going to have a hard time reading the box (light tan with white or gold lettering) and the bottle (yellow with white lettering). I had to take a picture of the ingredients and enlarge it just to see what it read. The lotion is made in Korea, and there is a very minimal scent - I barely notice anything at all, which is great. Most scents I find overbearing, so I'd rather have no scent for most products. The lotion comes out in a very light serum - not a thick lotion - but still thick enough that it doesn't drip through your fingers when applying. It absorbs very quickly, and I don't feel any stinging. It does feel fairly moisturizing. I do notice a very minimal clammy feeling on my face for a short while after applying, but only if I touch my face - my face itself feels fine and moisturized. I can't say that this is a miracle lotion - it hasn't changed the look of my face after using it for a week as far as I can tell, but it's a very nice lotion that works well for my t-zone mixed oily/dry skin. I don't smell some weird perfumey scent for an hour after applying, and it hasn't made me break out. All in all, a very nice basic lotion. Better than other brands I've tried, but not the absolute best ever. It's well worth the asking price. There is no SPF, so you'll want to use sunscreen on top if you go outside, but for

This product is advertised as a cream, but it's a gel. For those sensitive to scents this product carries no scent. It goes on nicely, absorbs well into the skin and is not sticky to the touch. With that said, I did not see much difference in my skin texture after using this product. Though it is obvious how to use this product the instructions on the box are not clear. This product has no "wow" factor to it. I would not purchase it again.

This gel moisturizer is quite soothing for my skin. It goes on easily and absorbs okay, but does leave my face very shiny. I've been using it at night because of that, and because it does an great job relieving redness from outbreaks when you leave it on overnight. My skin feels nicely hydrated after using this. I don't think I'll be using this as a daily moisturizer, but I do like it for those days when outbreaks are threatening, and I have used it also as a spot treatment over a different moisturizer for targeting specific areas and it works really well for that also. It's a nice gel to have handy for those time your skin needs that extra care.

This HYGGEE Relief Chamomile Cream is a nice basic cream. Goes on almost like a serum moisturizer, if that makes any sense. But feels hydrating like a cream. Little to no scent detected. I have fairly sensitive skin and had no adverse reactions. Love the added ingredients such as Chamomile Extract and Hyaluronic Acid, helps to calm and hydrate my skin. I don’t think it’s anything special, but it’s a nice basic cream and definitely worth trying out!

Review for: HYGGEE Relief Chamomile Cream - Hydrating Gel Face Moisturizer for Oily Skin I. LOVE. CHAMOMILE. I just love it. Give me all of the chamomile things, please. That being said - the scent of this cream is very light & hardly noticeable. What I will say is that it works well on my picky skin (combo type) especially during times of redness/irritation. It has a very calming effect. It does leave the skin a little bit more "dewy" than I like, and for that reason I don't use it as my daily moisturizer. I like to use it a few times a week when my skin is looking particularly angry.
This face wash wasn't drying on my dry skin type it felt clean and toned after the scent was good.

avis.titre: Excellent, super hydrating gel moisturizer; ideal for sensitive and dry skin
avis.texte: I'm in love with this gel moisturizer, and it's earned a spot on my regular skincare regimen. Even though it has a gel texture, it hydrates my skin like the highest quality cream moisturizers I've used. It absorbs quickly, but leaves a protective layer of hydration that lasts until my next cleansing. But it doesn't feel heavy, oily or sticky. It has no scent that I can detect. It's highly concentrated, so I only need a very small amount to cover my entire face very thoroughly. It hasn't aggravated my acne and eczema prone skin at all. It feels soothing and luxurious. I highly recommend this moisturizer for anyone with dry and/or sensitive skin.

HYGGEE Relief Chamomile Cream - Hydrating Gel Face Moisturizer for Oily Skin - Chamomile Extract and Hyaluronic Acid - Hypoallergenic Vegan Face Cream - Lightweight Gel, 3 fl.oz.…I like this gel/cream for my face. It does moisturize and helps calm a few places on my face where I had poison ivy. It’s unscented and I like that! Good sized tube and you just use a little. Would buy again!
